mainEntity.name: What does a CCTV drain inspection show that clearing does not?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing tells you the line is open again. It does not tell you why it closed, and it cannot tell you whether the pipe is sound. The camera answers both. It shows the cause, the exact position, the depth and the condition of the pipe wall, which is what decides whether you need a repair or simply a clear.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home for it?

acceptedAnswer.text: It helps, because the screen faces both ways and the findings make a great deal more sense while you are looking at them. If you cannot be there, the findings are explained afterwards.

mainEntity.name: Can the camera go through a blockage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not through a solid one. Where a line is completely blocked the usual order is to clear enough to get the camera past, then inspect, because an inspection that stops at the blockage does not tell you what caused it. On a line that is still flowing, the camera goes first. That is the better order whenever it is possible.

mainEntity.name: Will you try to sell me a repair?
